question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x) = P(X \leq x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(2) & =P(X\le 2) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1\})+P(X=2) \\  & =P(X\le 1)+P(X=2) \\  & =F(1)+P(X=2).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=2) & =F(2)-F(1) \\  & =0.0969-0.0170 \\  & =0.0799\end{aligned}
$$
